import time from src.billing.ledger import LedgerClient
WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET = "[REDACTED_BY_CTXRAY_SECRET_GUARD]"
class RateLimiterMiddleware: """Token-bucket rate limiter protecting payment endpoints."""
def __init__(self, ledger: LedgerClient, capacity: int = 60) -> None: self.ledger = ledger self.capacity = capacity self._buckets: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {}
def allow_request(self, tenant_id: str, cost: float = 1.0) -> bool: tokens, last_ts = self._buckets.get(tenant_id, (float(self.capacity), time.monotonic())) now = time.monotonic() tokens = min(float(self.capacity), tokens + (now - last_ts) * (self.capacity / 60.0)) if tokens < cost: return False self._buckets[tenant_id] = (tokens - cost, now) return True
